Click commands can be used to interact with game UI elements. You can use these in your macros.
entries.Translated: 点击命令可以用来与游戏 UI 元素交互。你可以在宏中使用这些命令。

entries.Original: Items in red are properties that themselves have methods (not callable directly).
entries.Translated: 红色项是本身具有方法的属性 (不能直接调用)。

entries.Translated: 以下命令可用于聊天或宏文本。

entries.Original: is an expansion of the native macro system, with smart helpers, additional commands and modifiers, and unlimited macros.
entries.Translated: 这是对原生宏系统的扩展，包括智能助手、额外的命令和修饰符，以及无限制的宏。

entries.Original: It also supports scripting with Lua, so you can write macros that are more complex than the native system can handle.
entries.Translated: 它还支持使用 Lua 语言编写脚本，因此你可以编写比原生系统更复杂的宏。

entries.Original: That status window shows all currently running macros and their current state
entries.Translated: 那个状态窗口显示所有当前运行的宏及其当前状态。

entries.Original: Ready: Macro has been loaded but hasn't started running
entries.Translated: 准备：宏已加载，但尚未开始运行
正在运行：宏当前正在运行

entries.Original: Paused: Macro execution has been temporarily stopped
entries.Translated: 暂停：宏执行已暂时停止

entries.Original: Failed: Macro encountered an error during execution
entries.Translated: 失败:Macro 在执行过程中遇到错误

entries.Original: Macros can be configured to trigger automatically based on specific game events:
entries.Translated: 宏可以配置为根据特定游戏事件自动触发：

entries.Original: Lua macros can also be configured to have individual functions trigger automatically (provided the script was already running).
entries.Translated: Lua 宏也可以配置为自动触发单个函数 (前提是脚本已经在运行)。

entries.Original: Any function that begins with the name of a TriggerEvent will be registered in the
entries.Translated: 任何以 TriggerEvent 名称开头的函数都将在其中注册。

entries.Translated: 具体而言，事件名称后必须紧跟加号名称和事件类型，例如

entries.Original: Macros can be configured with metadata to provide specific configurations to the framework regarding macro execution.
entries.Translated: 宏可以使用元数据进行配置，以便为框架提供与宏执行相关的特定配置。

entries.Original: The metadata can be edited in the Macros Settings section when a macro is selected in the library.
entries.Translated: 在资源库中选择宏时，可以在宏设置部分中编辑元数据。

entries.Original: The metadata can be written to the file using the button provided in the above section. This is crucial for macros stored remotely (i.e. github) for the framework to know what settings to use when they're imported
entries.Translated: 元数据可以使用上述部分提供的按钮写入文件。这对于框架的远程存储宏 (即 github) 来说至关重要，因为它们知道在导入时要使用哪些设置。

entries.Original: Macros can also be configured to require other plugins to run, and a message will be printed if the requirement is not met.
entries.Translated: 宏也可以配置为要求其他插件运行，如果未满足要求，则会打印一条消息。

entries.Original: Similiarly, macros can be configured to disable other plugins while running, though this requires plugins to be pre-defined in the framework to support this.
entries.Translated: 类似地，宏可以配置为在运行时禁用其他插件，尽管这需要框架中预定义的插件来支持这一点。

entries.Original: Like plugin dependencies, macros can support relying on other macros, whether they're local (already loaded into snd) or remote (i.e. github)
entries.Translated: 与插件依赖一样，宏可以支持对其他宏的依赖，无论是本地宏 (已加载到 snd 中) 还是远程宏 (例如 github)。

entries.Original: Macros can now be connected to a github url and auto converted into a "Git Macro"
entries.Translated: 宏现在可以连接到 github URL，并自动转换为 “Git 宏”。

entries.Original: Git macros support auto updating when a new version is released (checked on startup), and going between versions via the version history modal (found in the Macro Settings section)
entries.Translated: Git 宏支持在发布新版本时自动更新 (启动时检查)，并通过版本历史记录模式在版本之间切换 (可在宏设置部分中找到)。

entries.Original: A macro is automatically identified as a git macro when it has a repository url in its metadata. To convert a git macro back into a local macro, simply wipe the url or click the Reset Git Data button in the settings
entries.Translated: 当宏的元数据中包含仓库 URL 时，它会自动被标识为 git 宏。要将 git 宏转换回本地宏，只需擦除 URL 或点击设置中的 “重置 Git 数据” 按钮。

entries.Original: Use the /send command to simulate keyboard input. This is useful for interacting with UI elements that don't have dedicated click commands.
entries.Translated: 使用/send 命令模拟键盘输入。这对于与没有专用单击命令的 UI 元素交互很有用。

entries.Original: Below are all of the functions and properties provided by the framework. Click any to copy the full call path to clipboard. Hover any function to learn more about it.
entries.Translated: 以下是该框架提供的所有功能和属性。单击任何一个，将完整的调用路径复制到剪贴板。悬停任何功能以了解更多信息。

entries.Original: Reads metadata (author, version, description, dependencies, triggers) from the macro content and updates the settings.
entries.Translated: 从宏内容中读取元数据 (作者、版本、描述、依赖项、触发器)，并更新设置。

entries.Original: Wipes all git information and reverts this macro back to a standard local macro.
